title: Preserve playback speed and diagram options in Studio NarrationRequest

anchor.targetSnippet: export function parseNarrationRequest(body: unknown): NarrationRequest | null {

violation.problem: parseNarrationRequest silently drops speed and verbalizeDiagrams, preventing Studio users from configuring audio tempo or diagram verbalization options supported by the core CLI and pipeline.
violation.expectedSolution: Update NarrationRequest interface and parseNarrationRequest() to validate and preserve speed?: number (clamped between 0.5 and 2.5) and verbalizeDiagrams?: boolean.

steps: In studio/src/lib/narration-request.ts, add speed?: number and verbalizeDiagrams?: boolean to NarrationRequest interface.
In parseNarrationRequest(), parse and clamp speed if provided (0.5 to 2.5).
In parseNarrationRequest(), parse verbalizeDiagrams boolean flag.
Return both properties in the validated request object.
reviewChecklist: speed is preserved in NarrationRequest and clamped between 0.5 and 2.5
verbalizeDiagrams boolean flag is preserved in NarrationRequest
Invalid speed values gracefully clamp or default without rejecting valid requests
